description: DealKeep is the tracker for people who buy lifetime software deals. Connect it and ask, in plain language, about the stack you already own: "What do I have for email marketing?", "Do I already own something like this before I buy it?", "Which refund windows are about to close?", or "Are any of my tools' founders going quiet?" Five read-only tools cover it — search your tools, check a purchase for duplicates, pull one license's full detail, list your deals, and surface founder-risk signals. The connector is strictly read-only: it can look across your library but can never buy, redeem, edit, or delete anything, and it only ever sees your own data. Connect with your existing DealKeep account (dealkeep.io).
